title: Commanders GM Adam Peters: "More likely than not" we stay at No. 7 and pick

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Commanders GM Adam Peters: "More likely than not" we stay at No. 7 and pick
sources.description: Chiefs General Manager Brett Veach said this week that he expects a lot of trades in the first round of next week's draft, but any dealing may not include the Commanders.
